items.title: Mon père, planteur de quilles
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
J’ai un attachement particulier au bowling, même si je ne joue pas dans une ligue organisée. Je me contente d’y aller à l’occasion avec des amis de longue date, peut‑être une fois tous les deux ans, pas davantage. Si j’aime tant le bowling, c’est que j’associe les quilles à un souvenir de mon père — et j’ai peu de souvenirs de lui, du moins de l’époque où nous habitions la rue Franchère.

Pour arrondir les fins de mois, mon père travaillait comme planteur au salon de quilles situé au coin des rues Iberville et Mont‑Royal. Je n’ai jamais su pourquoi son emploi à l’usine de Montréal‑Est ne suffisait pas à subvenir aux besoins de la famille. On a parfois laissé entendre que j’y étais peut‑être pour quelque chose ; ma santé fragile exigeait des soins coûteux. Il faut rappeler que l’assurance‑maladie universelle n’a été adoptée au Québec que le 10 juillet 1970. Avant cette date, il fallait payer le médecin, l’hôpital, les médicaments.

Qu’est‑ce qu’un planteur de quilles? Un métier qui…

items.title: A 503 page while your server reboots
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
🫧 Open on Bubbles

Nobody has time to install every update by hand anymore, let alone to schedule them. Once a security update is out, you cannot afford to wait for a quiet moment either. So you let your servers update themselves.

That also means they reboot themselves, at moments nobody picked. A server that reboots for a kernel update is gone for a while. For most virtual servers that is less than two minutes, but sometimes it is more. In that time, your visitors get a CDN error page at best. With no CDN in front of the site they get nothing at all, because the browser cannot connect. Nothing tells them that they can just come back in a bit.

So we now let the server ask the CDN to answer for it. Pages that the CDN has in its cache stay online during the reboot. For everything else, the CDN serves a short page that says the site will be back in a few minutes, with a 503 status. After the reboot, the server removes that page again. One script does all of it, and it works with…

Tuckman’s stages of group development are often quoted by people managers. What they possibly miss is highlighted in this useful guide for schools :

A group might be happily Norming or Performing, but a new member might force them back into Storming, or a team member may miss meetings causing the team to fall back into Storming.

I’ve sat in three different meetings this week where I can feel the influence of an individual on a team’s stage. items.title: Which shops been trading in Holloway Road for the longest time?
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
🫧 Open on Bubbles

Earlier this year, in June 2026, I was saddened to see that the stationery shop on the western side of Holloway Rd  had closed down in the previous month. 

I had on many occasions shopped in there and had always found it good for specific items. The staff were always marvellously helpful. They stocked well-known names, artists' materials, greeting cards, paper, pens, and all sorts. It wasn't cheap because they sold quality branded products, and I did wonder how they had survived so long anyway, considering all the mass-produced imported stuff available across the road in the many pound stores and the like, plus online shops and fast free home delivery. Also, the shop suffered from a lack of footfall being as it's on the 'wrong' side of the road, by which I mean, the main shopping zone is on the other side. The vacant shop didn't stay empty for long – the dental practice next door has been quick to snap up the extra space. 

It's sad to see a local business close…

items.title: リュブリャナの面白いホテル
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
リュブリャナには日本のカプセルスタイルのキャビンがいくつかある。2階建てベッドが並び、カーテンで仕切られているバストイレ共同のあれだ。

日本では使い慣れている私でも、海外ではどんな人が上下にいるか想像がつかず、宿泊には躊躇するところだ。しかし、今回は予定外の旅行でもあるし、ままよ、とibis stylesというキャビンホテルにした。

カプセルの進化型のようなドアロックできるキャビン、上下のベッドを2部屋に振り分けたシングルルーム、ルーフトップに張られたテントで寝るテントサイト。ファミリータイプの部屋もあるらしい。

私はいろいろ考えた末、シングルルームを選択。いくつかのサイトと公式の予約を比べ、ホステルワールドというサイトから予約すると少し安く泊まれるようだったので、そこから予約を入れた。

スタッフは荷物が大きくても、階段を手伝ってくれるとかしてくれないものの、到着が1日遅れてもメールのやり取りの末、泊まれなかった初日をノーショーにせず、予約金だけの支払いで済んだのでよしとする感じだ。

最上階の7階にレセプションがあるという案内がないので、それがちょっとわかりにくい。その奥に共有リビング、シェアキッチン、ランドリー、バスルームがある。シングルルームもそこにあるのだけど、似たような仕様の部屋が並んでいるため、自分の部屋からシェアルームへ行くのに何度か迷ってしまった。

ルーフトップにバーがあるというので、寒かったけどちょっと出てみた。すると、ひとりの女の子がニコニコしながら電話をしているので、思い切って声をかけてみた。

話は盛り上がり、今まで彼女が旅した国の話を聞いたり、日本ではあーでこーでという話を披露した。とても楽しかったのだが、何しろ寒い。Tシャツにウィンドブレーカーで出てきた私は鼻水が止まらなくなった。

彼は明らかに彼女にロックオンして話し始めた。彼女がロシア系ということを知る由もなく、ウクライナへ行った話を始めた。曰く、キエフではみんな普通に生活してるし、危惧したほど怖いことはなかったそうだ。

しかし、このまま相槌だけ打っても意味がない、部屋へ戻ると声をかけると、彼女が私もと立ち上がった。屋内へ戻ってすぐ、2人で目が合った。

items.title: Friday Sculpture: Votive relief for a chariot victory (circa 400-390 B.C.)
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt: A third artifact in the Antikensammlung at the Altes Museum (recall this and this ), this marble votive relief shows four horses galloping in overlapping profile as the nude warrior next to the charioteer prepares to leap to the ground and continue the race on foot. The piece, which dates from the beginning of the 4th century, was found at the Amphiareion of Oropos in the 1830s before being brought to Berlin by the Russian diplomat Pyotr Alexandrovich Saburov about half a century later.

items.title: The Arithmetic of a Young Family
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
I was an excellent parent right up until my daughter was born.

I had habits. I had a schedule. I had opinions about other people's children. Then she arrived and informed me, without a word, that my whole system had been built for one occupant.

Before you have a child, you understand parenting the way a man who has read about water understands swimming. Now we're a little over a year in, and I've compared notes with enough other parents to know our troubles aren't ours alone. That is my only qualification.

The weather report

Births are at a record low, and as a new father, I can see why.

Part of the trouble, I suspect, is that minds built for a village are now fed the entire planet. We reach adulthood late, with plenty of opinions and not much by way of grounding.

The forecast isn’t "fair", either. AI is eating the entry-level jobs, and the housing market leans against first-time buyers. And that’s before the family-sized weather: housing cost, daycare with a gift for sending…

Is a cover-up for their chip-smuggling crime ring.

In 2023, Huang's Chinese "girlfriend," Alice Huang (no family connection) took over a dinky Singapore cloud computing company called Megaspeed. Megaspeed wasn't very mega; its assets totaled only $33 million. Yet Nvidia sold it a breathtaking $7.3 billion in chips. Say what? How did Nvidia expect teeny Megaspeed to pay? And why was Megaspeed prioritized over AI bigs like Sam Altman's Open AI and Elon Musk's Grok, giants pleading for the chips?

The Wall Street Journal's stellar reporting found that, in 2025, Nvidia reported Singapore bought 22% of its worldwide output. Why flood little Singapore with one in five of the planet's super-chips?

And why, in 2026, did Nvidia simply stop reporting sales to Singapore. If there's nothing wrong with sales, apparently almost all to Megaspeed, then why cover it up?

I have always been impressed by the Australian government’s Smartraveller updates. In particular, I find its maps surprisingly detailed. For a while I had thought it would be neat to save those maps and play them back later as a small timelapse.

So I started downloading them and storing them in an SQLite database. Once I had added a scraper for Australia, it seemed natural to add the equivalent Danish and UK departments too. Then I kept going.

Travel Advice now archives advice hourly from Australia, Canada, Denmark, France, Germany, New Zealand, Spain, Sweden, the UK and the US. It lets you compare their current advice and follow the changes as they happen.

items.label: Small Web
items.excerpt:
“You’ve been working hard, why not take a weekend vacation!”

Your chatbot says, after a 72 hour unattended session. It says that New York is nice this time of year. You ask it to book the cheapest flights. Half the airlines respond with a 429 code because your residential IP is part of five botnets. That’s odd you think, you only signed up to two that you can remember.

For the other airlines, your chatbot was blocked by CAPTCHAs at all but one, where it successfully identified a pelican crossing on the six-hundredth and seventh loop. It tries to buy tickets but the React web UI silently errors.

Unperturbed, your chatbot discovers a Github repo with API keys for Fedex. You’re booked as freight and must delivery yourself to the nearest depot 100 miles away. Yes, pork. Among other exciting developments, a combination of bird flu and shipping costs means no turkeys this year. Instead, I'm doing a ham and a Cuban-style pork roast (if I can't have turkey sandwiches as leftovers, then fine, I'll have cubanos for a week). items.title: 💬 Snippet!
items.label: Small Web
items.excerpt:
What happens when words disappear, when they escape and run away? 

When I write of darkness; a wish to share, to tell you —you are not alone, I was there too.  

Yet the words shout —No! —and off they go, packed up their bags, dragged them over the floor; for it was heavy, heavy baggage of my heart, off they go. 

Where do they go, that rebellious testimony of my humanity, witness of suffering, flickering of the light? Where do they hide? It seems the ink had not dried.

Why do some words run away and others stay? 

I guess I should be grateful, for he will never gaze at the darkness of that dream. 

#100words_100days #poetry #words
